title: Covey plugin catalogue
description: The generated file a Covey instance fetches from COVEY_MARKETPLACE_URL. Assembled by CI from the entries under plugins/ — do not edit by hand. Published here so that anyone serving their own catalogue can check its shape against the same definition.

schema.description: Format version of the catalogue itself. It changes only on a breaking change; an instance that does not know the version must ignore the catalogue rather than guess at it.

generated_at.description: When CI assembled this file (UTC). Informational — an instance decides staleness by its own fetch, not by this.

plugins.description: Every entry from plugins/, sorted by name.
